question: What must an applicant provide to evidence a common-law union?

claims.text: The applicant must submit a Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union form (IMM 5409) and evidence of cohabitation for a period of at least 12 continuous months.
claims.quote: Statutory Declaration of Common-Law Union form [[IMM 5409 (PDF, 636.51 KB)](https://www.canada.ca/content/dam/ircc/migration/ircc/english/pdf/kits/forms/imm5409e.pdf)] and evidence of cohabitation for a period of at least 12 continuous months.
